g.aria-label: box phase_two: PHASE 2 — memory + thermal + efficiency tuning
box gate_two: GATE — improvement is repeatable and worth added power / complexity
g.text: GATE — improvement is repeatable and worth added power / complexity

g.aria-label: box unlock_optional: OPTIONAL — qualify 40-CU / 8-core paths with rollback and correctness tests
g.text: OPTIONAL — qualify 40-CU / 8-core paths with rollback and correctness tests

g.aria-label: box phase_three: PHASE 3 — second node
box network_test: NETWORK TEST — dedicated 2.5 GbE backend; request sharding vs llama.cpp RPC model split
g.text: NETWORK TEST — dedicated 2.5 GbE backend; request sharding vs llama.cpp RPC model split

g.aria-label: box gate_three: GATE — larger-model quality or concurrency justifies second-node watts and latency
g.text: GATE — larger-model quality or concurrency justifies second-node watts and latency

g.aria-label: box phase_four: PHASE 4 — router + specialist workers
box worker_roles: ROLES — fast / code / RAG-batch / speech / image / evaluation
g.text: ROLES — fast / code / RAG-batch / speech / image / evaluation

g.aria-label: box operations: OPERATIONS — config management / monitoring / health / API policy / model-version inventory
g.text: OPERATIONS — config management / monitoring / health / API policy / model-version

g.aria-label: box phase_five: PHASE 5 — fleet or rack only if the economics still win
g.text: PHASE 5 — fleet or rack only if the economics still win

g.aria-label: box fleet_gate: FLEET GATE — compare throughput per dollar and per watt against simpler alternative hardware
g.text: FLEET GATE — compare throughput per dollar and per watt against simpler alternative

g.text: END STATE — measured, reproducible local AI fabric
